description: Get daily, weekly or monthly OHLC bars for the continuous (auto-rolled) Brent or WTI front-month futures series between two dates. Use when the user wants one long front-month price series for charting or backtesting, rather than per-contract history. These bars come from collected public futures snapshots and can be revised; they are not official exchange settlements, so use opa_get_futures_history for per-contract settlements. Without from, the API returns its permitted history window; dates cannot be in the future. The answer shows at most 400 bars and says what it left out. Historical depth depends on the account's futures entitlement, and the answer states any start-date cap the API applied. Requires an eligible account entitlement. Use opa_get_plans for current access and pricing; the API response is authoritative.

contract.description: Continuous series: brent or wti (default: brent).

from.description: Inclusive start date, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). Optional; omit for the API's permitted history window.

interval.description: Bar size: daily, weekly or monthly (default: daily).

to.description: Inclusive end date, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). Defaults to today.

name: opa_get_continuous_futures_history
title: Get Continuous Futures History
